prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. Interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image: "Zellentrakt", the cell block of a cyberpunk prison - scuffed grey-green painted concrete floor with yellow guide lines as the walkable area, harsh fluorescent ceiling light, damp stains. Keep all important objects inside the central area; the outer strips at the far left and right edges are plain wall or floor.
LEFT HALF: the visiting room - a long counter running across under a thick scratched glass partition with small speaking grilles and old phone handsets, the prisoner side behind the glass on top; plastic chairs on the visitor side; a waiting bench and a vending machine; a "no smoking" style pictogram (symbol only, no letters).
RIGHT HALF, TOP ROW: three prison cells side by side with heavy steel bars at the front - the most eye-catching spot: LEFT cell tidy with a folded jacket and a stack of letters and a scratched tally on the wall; MIDDLE cell (open to the floor, walkable inside) with a narrow steel bunk with a thin mattress and grey blanket, a steel toilet, scratched messages without letters; RIGHT cell cosy with a small plant, a crocheted blanket and a teapot.
RIGHT HALF, MIDDLE: a straight corridor with yellow lines leading along the cell bars.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a solid wall with closed steel cell doors and small hatches.
BOTTOM LEFT: the heavy steel door out to the courtyard with a little guard desk and a key cabinet next to it.
Small stuff at the edges: a fire extinguisher, a mop, a security camera, cables and pipes drawn thin.
EXITS clearly readable: BOTTOM edge left - the steel door out to the courtyard.
Time: night, cold fluorescent light, a single red lamp, warm glow from the right cell.
